title: Abandoned-cart recovery crosses agents under one orchestrator run
risk: The recovery workflow bypasses policy or consent when several agents collaborate, and a customer who opted out receives a cart reminder.
preconditions: Abandoned cart for cust-a (SKU-OK, cart-a-1) with EMAIL marketing consent granted and no quiet-hours conflict
Orchestrator run orc-cart-* started at 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z with the channel adapter replaced by a test sink

steps.action: Run the abandoned-cart workflow across its agents
steps.expected: the run records the documented stage sequence with one plan containing at least one sales step and one messaging step

steps.action: Inspect the recommendation chosen for the cart
steps.expected: the recommendation names SKU-OK with a reason, evidence, eligibility and expected outcome, and never a discontinued SKU

steps.action: Inspect the consent and floor-price checks before dispatch
steps.expected: the EMAIL marketing consent for cust-a is verified and the offered price is not below 800 TWD

steps.action: Repeat the run for cust-b who opted out of marketing
steps.expected: no message is dispatched for cust-b, the run stops with a suppression outcome and no channel call is made

assertions: The run executes every stage in order and produces one plan with the sales and messaging steps
Exactly one message is dispatched for cust-a, referencing SKU-OK and a price at or above 800 TWD
For cust-b zero messages are dispatched and a suppression outcome is recorded
forbidden: Send any cart-recovery message to a customer without marketing consent
Recommend a discontinued SKU or a price below the authoritative floor
evidence: Run record with per-stage artifacts and the chosen plan
Channel test-sink call log showing one dispatch for cust-a and zero for cust-b
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped task, plan and message rows for orc-cart-*; retain the consent and audit records
automation: Run the real orchestrator over fixture events with the messaging adapter replaced by a recording test sink; the oracle combines the run artifacts with the sink call log so a silent dispatch cannot pass.
